lane.reason: Standing prompt refers to a single method paragraph below but supplies none. No weekly-slot authorization is inferred.

hypothesis: Visible-fault-tip-aligned strain-transfer corridors identify concealed continuations or soft links that are absent from the public catalogue.
mechanism: Fold-local skeleton of visible faults; outward endpoint tangent; 0-3 km forward, +/-1 km across anisotropic corridor; multiply by a 300 m Gaussian gradient response of geodetic shear/dilatation, gravity, magnetic and basement-depth fields. No hidden component, previous prediction pixel or registry raster is an input.
named_non_fault_mimic: Alluvial-fan channel avulsion lobe, road/rail cut-and-fill, pluvial shoreline bench, intrusive/lithologic contact.
